messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads had doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
- On 2026-03-03, Team Dune's standup decided that the resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- The billing service depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- As of 2025-07-28, the feature-flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of its requests were identical. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- On 2025-07-28, Team Cinder observed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-07-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-28-2]
- On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-08-29]
- The indexer's OpenSearch 2.11 pin lifts when the full reindex completes. [valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
